text: Just as a person, when reflecting on what is true here, what is supreme, what is the highest good, and what constitutes the fulfillment of life, comes to know the truth, so too does knowledge arise: that the Purusha is distinct from the Pradhana; that there is a separate intellect (buddhi), a separate ego (ahamkara), separate subtle elements (tanmatras), separate senses, and separate five great elements. Thus, true knowledge (tatva-jnana) arises, which leads to liberation. This is the first attainment (siddhi) of the Uha school.
